tools.name: AddBlueprintArrayOperationNode
tools.description: Adds a typed Blueprint array operation node and resolves its wildcard array and item pins.

typeObjectPath.description: Required class path when elementType is object or class.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh the index after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintBranchNode
tools.description: Adds a collision-aware Branch node to a stable Blueprint graph. Supports explicit or relative placement, dry-run, and optional save.

graphName.description: Stable graphName from ListBlueprintGraphs, or unique display name.

dryRun.description: Resolve graph and preview collision-aware placement without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh this Blueprint after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintCastNode
tools.description: Adds a typed Dynamic Cast node with optional pure mode, collision-aware placement, dry-run, and optional save.

pure.description: Create a pure cast without exec pins.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintCommentNode
tools.description: Adds a bounded Blueprint graph comment with explicit text, collision-aware placement, size, dry-run, and optional save.

showBubbleWhenZoomed.description: Show bubble when zoomed; defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintComponent
tools.description: Transactionally adds one component to a Blueprint SCS with optional editable template property defaults. Idempotent by component name.

componentClassPath.description: UActorComponent-derived /Script/... or generated Blueprint class path.

propertyDefaults.description: Optional editable component-template properties. Values must be JSON primitives or Unreal export-text strings.

updateExistingDefaults.description: If the named component already exists, explicitly update supplied propertyDefaults. Defaults false.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile only this Blueprint after mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after mutation.

tools.name: AddBlueprintComponents
tools.description: Prevalidates and transactionally adds an ordered component set to one Blueprint, then optionally compiles, saves, and partially refreshes the index once.

components.description: Ordered components to add. The entire batch is validated before mutation.

parentComponentName.description: Optional scene-component parent. A batch parent must appear earlier in the array.

propertyDefaults.description: Optional editable template properties using JSON primitives or Unreal export-text strings.

dryRun.description: Validate the complete batch without mutation.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile once after the batch. Defaults to true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index once. Defaults to true.

tools.name: AddBlueprintCustomEventNode
tools.description: Adds a uniquely named Custom Event to a stable Blueprint graph with collision-aware layout, dry-run, and optional save.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintDelegateBroadcastNode
tools.description: Adds a Call Delegate node for an exact Blueprint-callable multicast delegate property.

ownerClassPath.description: Exact class that declares the BlueprintCallable multicast delegate.

dryRun.description: Validate access, signature, graph compatibility, and placement without editing.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save the Blueprint and partially refresh its index entry.

tools.name: AddBlueprintDelegateEventNode
tools.description: Adds a uniquely named Custom Event whose parameter pins exactly match a reflected Blueprint-assignable multicast delegate signature.

ownerClassPath.description: Exact class that declares the delegate.

delegateName.description: Exact BlueprintAssignable multicast delegate property name.

eventName.description: Unique Custom Event name to create.

dryRun.description: Validate the exact delegate signature and placement.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: AddBlueprintDelegateNode
tools.description: Adds a Bind or Unbind node for an exact Blueprint-assignable multicast delegate property on a reflected owner class.

ownerClassPath.description: Exact class that declares the BlueprintAssignable delegate.

operation.description: bind or unbind; defaults to bind.

dryRun.description: Validate the delegate signature and placement.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: AddBlueprintFunctionCallNode
tools.description: Adds a function-call node from an exact owner class and function name with collision-aware placement, dry-run, and optional save.

ownerClassPath.description: Optional exact owner class; defaults to the target Blueprint generated class.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintFunctionParameter
tools.description: Transactionally adds one typed input or output parameter to a Blueprint function graph identified by graphGuid.

graphGuid.description: Stable GUID of the target function graph.

type.description: Scalar type, or Map key type.

typeObjectPath.description: Required class path for object/class types.

valueTypeObjectPath.description: Class path for object/class Map values.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after mutation.

tools.name: AddBlueprintInterface
tools.description: Attaches an exact Blueprint interface transactionally, with dry-run, duplicate/inherited detection, collision refusal, compile rollback and optional save. Refuses saving pre-existing unsaved work.

objectPath.description: Exact Blueprint asset or interface class path.

interfaceClassPath.description: Exact Blueprint asset or interface class path.

dryRun.description: Dry-run false, compile true, save false by default. Saving forces compilation.

compileAfterEdit.description: Dry-run false, compile true, save false by default. Saving forces compilation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Dry-run false, compile true, save false by default. Saving forces compilation.

tools.name: AddBlueprintInterfaceEventNode
tools.description: Adds an implemented Blueprint interface function as an event node in an exact Ubergraph, with idempotent duplicate detection, dry-run, and optional save.

graphName.description: Exact Ubergraph name; graphGuid is preferred when available.

interfaceClassPath.description: Exact /Script/... or generated Blueprint interface class path.

dryRun.description: Validate the interface event and preview placement without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh this Blueprint after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintInterfaceFunctionGraph
tools.description: Creates the signature-correct function-graph implementation for a non-event Blueprint interface function, including output and return signatures.

interfaceClassPath.description: Exact /Script/... or generated Blueprint interface class path.

dryRun.description: Validate and report whether the interface graph would be created.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the Blueprint after creation.

tools.name: AddBlueprintLocalVariable
tools.description: Transactionally adds a typed local variable to one Blueprint function graph (type/containerType/valueType as in AddBlueprintVariable). Idempotent by name. Use AddBlueprintVariableGetNode/SetNode-style graph tools or ApplyBlueprintGraphPatch afterwards to read/write it.

graphName.description: Function graph name (or name::guid) from ListBlueprintGraphs.

graphGuid.description: Function graph GUID; alternative to graphName.

type.description: Type name as in AddBlueprintVariable (bool, int, float, string, object, struct, ...).

typeObjectPath.description: Class/struct/enum path for object, class, struct or enum types.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after the edit (default false).

tools.name: AddBlueprintMacroNode
tools.description: Adds a macro instance from a Blueprint macro library, including StandardMacros such as ForEachLoop.

objectPath.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

macroName.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

macroLibraryPath.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

relativeToNodeGuid.description: Blueprint graph, macro, or placement selector.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintMapOperationNode
tools.description: Adds a persistent typed Blueprint Map operation node with independently resolved key and value pins.

keyTypeObjectPath.description: Class path for object/class key types.

valueTypeObjectPath.description: Class path for object/class value types.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintOverrideEventNode
tools.description: Adds an overrideable parent-class Blueprint event to an exact Blueprint graph with collision-aware placement, dry-run, duplicate rejection, and optional save.

functionName.description: Exact overrideable Blueprint event name on the parent class.

dryRun.description: Validate the event and preview placement without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh this Blueprint after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintRerouteNode
tools.description: Adds a wildcard Reroute node with collision-aware placement. Its pin type specializes when connected.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintSequenceNode
tools.description: Adds a collision-aware Sequence node to a stable Blueprint graph. Supports dry-run and optional save.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddBlueprintSetOperationNode
tools.description: Adds a persistent typed Blueprint Set operation node with resolved element pins.

elementType.description: Set element type: bool, float, int, string, name, text, object, or class.

typeObjectPath.description: Required class path when elementType is object or class.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintTypedOperatorNode
tools.description: Adds an exact object, Boolean, or Vector operator node without ambiguous function lookup.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after adding.

tools.name: AddBlueprintVariable
tools.description: Transactionally adds a typed Blueprint member variable with optional default, instance-editable metadata, compile, and save.

type.description: Scalar type, or Map key type.

typeObjectPath.description: Required class path for object/class types.

valueTypeObjectPath.description: Class path for object/class Map values.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after mutation.

objectPath.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

variableName.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

tools.name: AddBlueprintVariableSetNode
tools.description: Adds a variable Set node for an exact Blueprint member with collision-aware placement, dry-run, and optional save.

objectPath.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

variableName.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

relativeToNodeGuid.description: Blueprint member, graph, or placement selector.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: AddDataTableRow
tools.description: Transactionally edits one DataTable row in memory; leaves the asset dirty for an explicit save.

tools.name: AddEnhancedInputActionNode
tools.description: Adds an Enhanced Input Action event node for an exact InputAction asset without requiring Enhanced Input as a hard plugin dependency.

dryRun.description: Validate asset, plugin availability, graph, and placement.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: AddInputMappingContextMapping
tools.description: Adds one key-mapping row to an existing InputMappingContext. Idempotent if the identical Action+Key row already exists.

inputActionPath.description: Exact UInputAction asset object path to map.

key.description: FKey name, for example LeftMouseButton, MiddleMouseButton, W, Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom.

dryRun.description: Validate asset/action/key without adding the mapping.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: AnalyzeBlueprintCoupling
tools.description: Ranks project Blueprint assets by indexed package dependency coupling. This is static package-reference analysis, not runtime call coupling.

rootPath.description: Optional project package-path prefix such as /Game/Features. Alias of packagePath.

packagePath.description: Optional project package-path prefix such as /Game/Features. Alias of rootPath.

objectPath.description: Optional exact Blueprint object path to analyze one asset while retaining the selected package scope as the internal boundary.

maxResults.description: Maximum ranked assets to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped from 1 to 200.

tools.name: AnalyzeFeatureBoundary
tools.description: Analyzes static indexed package dependencies crossing a required /Game feature boundary. It does not infer runtime architecture.

rootPath.description: Required feature boundary under /Game. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

packagePath.description: Required feature boundary under /Game. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

maxResults.description: Maximum exact crossing edges, ranked boundary Blueprints, and packages per outside-scope group to return. Defaults to 100.

inputSchema.description: Provide either rootPath or packagePath; one is required and both must match when supplied.

tools.name: AnalyzeProjectArchitecture
tools.description: Returns a compact, fault-tolerant static architecture overview composed from the indexed cycle, coupling, broken-reference, unused-candidate, and optional feature-boundary analyses.

rootPath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

packagePath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

featureBoundaries.description: Optional /Game feature boundaries to summarize independently, up to 20.

maxResultsPerSection.description: Maximum evidence items requested from each section and maximum prioritized hotspots returned.

includeEvidence.description: Include each bounded composed tool result. False returns compact section counts and top hotspots only.

tools.name: ApplyBlueprintGraphPatch
tools.description: Atomically preflights and applies a bounded declarative Blueprint graph patch with deterministic node identities, exact data-link replacement, rollback, and compile-before-save.

objectPath.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

patchId.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

expectedGraphRevision.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

operationId.description: Blueprint, graph, deterministic patch, or revision selector.

nodes.description: Required node kinds: existingNode, functionCall, variableGet, variableSet, typedOperator, branch, reroute, and comment. Nodes may include position, comment, tolerance, and inputDefaults.

pinName.description: Exact input pin and one default source.

defaultValue.description: Exact input pin and one default source.

defaultObjectPath.description: Exact input pin and one default source.

connections.description: Exact output-to-input connections. Occupied data inputs require exact existing source fields plus confirmDataReplacement=true.

sourceNodeId.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

sourcePinName.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

targetNodeId.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

targetPinName.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

existingSourceNodeId.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

existingSourcePinName.description: Plan node id and exact pin name.

confirmDataReplacement.description: Explicitly confirm replacement of the identified occupied data link.

sourcePinName.description: Plan node id and exact linked pin name.

targetNodeId.description: Plan node id and exact linked pin name.

targetPinName.description: Plan node id and exact linked pin name.

detailLevel.description: summary (default) returns identities and link results; full includes every node pin.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile the edited Blueprint before any save. Defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh only after successful compilation. Defaults false.

tools.name: ApplyBlueprintInteractionPlan
tools.description: Preflights and idempotently applies Blueprint interaction nodes, exact named-pin connections, and safe Sequence splices that preserve an existing execution route.

objectPath.description: Blueprint, graph, or stable workflow selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint, graph, or stable workflow selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint, graph, or stable workflow selector.

workflowId.description: Blueprint, graph, or stable workflow selector.

nodes.description: Nodes: existingNode, customEvent, functionCall, variableGet, branch, or sequence. A sequence safely preserves one existing exec route via spliceAfterNodeId/spliceAfterPinName.

id.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

type.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

nodeGuid.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

eventName.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

ownerClassPath.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

functionName.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

variableName.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

spliceAfterNodeId.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

spliceAfterPinName.description: Stable node identity, kind, or type-specific reflected member selector.

inputDefaults.description: Optional exact input-pin defaults applied before connection validation. Each entry uses defaultValue or defaultObjectPath.

pinName.description: Exact input pin and literal or UObject/UClass default.

defaultValue.description: Exact input pin and literal or UObject/UClass default.

defaultObjectPath.description: Exact input pin and literal or UObject/UClass default.

sourceNodeId.description: Plan node id or exact live pin name.

sourcePinName.description: Plan node id or exact live pin name.

targetNodeId.description: Plan node id or exact live pin name.

targetPinName.description: Plan node id or exact live pin name.

executionInsertions.description: Atomic idempotent insertion of one impure node into an exact existing exec link.

sourceNodeId.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

sourcePinName.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

insertedNodeId.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

insertedInputPinName.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

insertedOutputPinName.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

targetNodeId.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

targetPinName.description: Exact plan node id and exec pin name.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile once after changes. Defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh once. Defaults true.

tools.name: AssetExists
tools.description: Checks whether an asset exists by object path without loading it.

tools.name: BuildProjectIndex
tools.description: Expensive manual action that builds or rebuilds the local UnrealMCP project-understanding index. Prefer user-triggered rebuilds instead of automatic agent-triggered rebuilds.

tools.name: CompareBlueprintClassDefaults
tools.description: Compares two Blueprint CDOs by property name, including properties present on one side only.

onlyDifferent.description: Return only differing or missing properties; default true.

tools.name: CompileAllBlueprints
tools.description: Compiles multiple Blueprint assets under a package path and returns aggregate results.

packagePath.description: Package path scope, for example /Game. Defaults to /Game.

recursive.description: Whether to recurse subfolders. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Optional max number of Blueprints to compile. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: CompileBlueprint
tools.description: Compiles one Blueprint asset and returns structured status, errors[{graph,nodeGuid,message}] and warnings[] plus the raw message list.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: ConnectBlueprintPins
tools.description: Validates and transactionally connects Blueprint pins, returning their resolved post-connection type model.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after connection.

tools.name: ConsolidateAndDeleteAsset
tools.description: Editor 'Replace References' equivalent: repoints every referencer of oldAssetPath to replacementAssetPath, then deletes the old asset (leaving a redirector as the editor does). Requires confirm=true unless dryRun=true; dry-run lists the referencers that would be touched. Does not save: dirtied packages are returned so they can be saved explicitly.

replacementAssetPath.description: Asset all references are repointed to; must be a compatible type.

confirm.description: Required for a real run: the old asset is deleted.

tools.name: CreateBlueprintAsset
tools.description: Creates a Blueprint asset with an explicit parent class. Rejects overwrite and supports dry-run and optional saving.

packagePath.description: New /Game/... package path without .uasset. Existing assets are never overwritten.

parentClassPath.description: Parent /Script/... or generated Blueprint class path.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save immediately after creation. Defaults to false.

tools.name: CreateBlueprintFunctionGraph
tools.description: Creates a uniquely named user Blueprint function graph and returns stable graph, entry, and return identities. Supports dry-run and optional save.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: CreateInputAction
tools.description: Creates a new UInputAction asset with an explicit value type. Rejects overwrite and supports dry-run and optional saving.

packagePath.description: New /Game/... package path without .uasset. Existing assets are never overwritten.

valueType.description: Boolean, Axis1D, Axis2D, or Axis3D (matches EInputActionValueType).

saveAfterEdit.description: Save immediately after creation. Defaults to false.

tools.name: CreateInputMappingContext
tools.description: Creates a new UInputMappingContext asset. Rejects overwrite and supports dry-run and optional saving.

packagePath.description: New /Game/... package path without .uasset. Existing assets are never overwritten.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save immediately after creation. Defaults to false.

tools.name: DeleteBlueprintNode
tools.description: Deletes one Blueprint graph node by stable GUID. Requires confirm=true, supports dry-run, and reports affected pin links.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after deletion.

tools.name: DiscardDirtyPackagesForShutdown
tools.description: Clears dirty flags on explicitly discarded editor packages before shutdown, without saving them.

confirm.description: Required to discard unsaved package changes.

dryRun.description: List dirty packages without clearing flags.

restoreDirty.description: Restore dirty flags for exact packageNames if shutdown did not finish.

packageNames.description: Optional exact package names to discard; omitted means all dirty packages.

tools.name: DisconnectBlueprintPins
tools.description: Disconnects one exact Blueprint pin link or all links on one pin. Requires confirmation unless dry-run and reports affected links.

objectPath.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

graphName.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

graphGuid.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

sourceNodeGuid.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

sourcePinId.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

sourcePinName.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

targetNodeGuid.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

targetPinId.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

targetPinName.description: Stable graph/node/pin selector. Omit target selectors to disconnect all source-pin links.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: ExplainBlueprintRole
tools.description: Returns a structured indexed summary that helps explain a Blueprint's likely role, neighbors, and composition inside the project.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: ExplainBlueprintTrace
tools.description: Explains an indexed Blueprint trace in a higher-level, token-efficient summary with confidence markers and cross-Blueprint notes.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

startNodeQuery.description: Optional node, event, function, variable, graph, or pin text to choose start nodes. When omitted, graph entry nodes are used.

direction.description: Traversal direction: forward, backward, or both. Defaults to forward.

resolveExternalMembers.description: Optional. When true, resolve node member owners back to indexed assets. Defaults to true.

expandCalls.description: Optional. When true, the explanation may continue into called functions or custom events. Defaults to true.

followCrossBlueprintCalls.description: Optional. When true, bounded call expansion may continue into target Blueprints. Defaults to true.

maxDepth.description: Optional max traversal depth. Defaults to 4.

maxNodes.description: Optional max traced node count. Defaults to 32.

maxStartNodes.description: Optional max matched start nodes. Defaults to 6.

maxCallDepth.description: Optional max call expansion depth. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: ExplainFeatureWorkflow
tools.description: Explains a feature query by ranking likely entry assets, then summarizing each candidate's role and nearby indexed flow.

query.description: Feature name, asset name, or path fragment to explain, for example inventory, Door, or NiceActor.

blueprintsOnly.description: Whether to only use Blueprint assets as workflow entry points. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Optional max entry points from 1 to 5. Defaults to 3.

packagePath.description: Optional package path prefix such as /Game/UI to narrow the search.

contextObjectPath.description: Optional related asset object path to boost directly connected candidates.

contextPackageName.description: Optional related asset package name when object path is not available.

flowMaxDepth.description: Optional flow traversal depth from 1 to 3. Defaults to 2.

flowMaxNodes.description: Optional flow traversal node cap from 1 to 30. Defaults to 12.

tools.name: FindActorsUsingBlueprint
tools.description: Finds actors in the active editor world whose class was generated from a specific Blueprint asset.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor.

packageName.description: Optional Blueprint package name when objectPath is not provided.

limit.description: Optional max number of matching actors to return. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: FindAssetsByClass
tools.description: Finds assets by Asset Registry class path, optionally scoped to a package path.

classPath.description: Class path to search for, for example /Script/Engine.Blueprint.

packagePath.description: Optional package path scope, for example /Game.

recursivePaths.description: Whether to recurse package subpaths when packagePath is supplied. Defaults to true.

includeDerivedClasses.description: Whether to include derived classes. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: FindAssetsByPath
tools.description: Finds assets under a package path, optionally filtered by class.

packagePath.description: Package path to search under, for example /Game/MyFolder.

recursive.description: Whether to recurse subfolders. Defaults to true.

classPath.description: Optional class path filter, for example /Script/Engine.Blueprint.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: FindBlueprintNodeReferences
tools.description: Finds indexed Blueprint nodes that reference a component variable, function, event, or other member across the project.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path that owns the target component variable, function, event, or node member.

query.description: Optional fuzzy lookup text matched against node titles, member names, and graph names.

memberName.description: Optional exact component variable, function, or event member name such as AC_MyFeature or SendGoldEvent.

nodeGuid.description: Optional exact node GUID when you want to target a known node identity.

includeSameBlueprint.description: Optional. When false, only return references from other Blueprints.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of references to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: FindBlueprintTraceStartPoints
tools.description: Finds likely indexed Blueprint graph nodes to use as trace starting points, ranked for tracing workflows.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

query.description: Optional query used to rank likely start nodes by node title, member name, node name, or graph name.

graphName.description: Optional Blueprint graph name filter, such as EventGraph or a function graph name.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of ranked start points to return. Defaults to 12.

includeEvents.description: Optional. When true, include event and custom event nodes. Defaults to true.

includeFunctionEntries.description: Optional. When true, include function entry nodes. Defaults to true.

includeCallSites.description: Optional. When true, include call-function nodes, especially useful for cross-Blueprint tracing. Defaults to true.

crossBlueprintOnly.description: Optional. When true, return only call sites that target another Blueprint asset.

tools.name: FindBlueprintVariableUsage
tools.description: Finds indexed Blueprint nodes that appear to read or write a variable, and summarizes their local connection counts.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

variableName.description: Variable name or partial variable text to search for in the indexed Blueprint graph.

graphName.description: Optional Blueprint graph name filter, such as EventGraph.

tools.name: FindBrokenBlueprintReferences
tools.description: Finds project Blueprint references that are provably unresolved in the current project index. This is static index evidence, not a live compiler check.

objectPath.description: Optional exact indexed project Blueprint object path.

rootPath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. Alias of packagePath.

packagePath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. Alias of rootPath.

categories.description: Optional evidence categories to include. Omit to run every category.

maxResults.description: Maximum findings to return after deterministic sorting. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: FindCircularDependencies
tools.description: Finds deterministic circular dependency groups among indexed project Blueprints. Use the reported internal edges to identify dependency seams to break.

rootPath.description: Optional project package-path prefix to analyze, for example /Game/Features. Alias of packagePath.

packagePath.description: Optional project package-path prefix to analyze recursively, for example /Game/Features.

minCycleSize.description: Minimum number of Blueprints in a returned circular group. Defaults to 2; use 1 to include direct self-cycles.

maxResults.description: Maximum circular groups returned after deterministic size/name ordering. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: FindClassUsages
tools.description: Finds every use of a class/struct/enum/asset inside one Blueprint, tagged by kind (cast_target, function_call, variable_access, pin_type, pin_default, function_parameter, local_variable, member_variable, component, parent_class, interface) with graph/node GUID/pin, including collapsed graphs. Reports registryDependency and a stale_import_only hit when the package still depends on the target but no live use exists.

classOrAssetPath.description: Class, struct, enum or asset to look for, e.g. /Game/BP_Vehicle.BP_Vehicle or /Game/BP_Vehicle.BP_Vehicle_C

limit.description: Max hits returned (default 100, max 500); totalHits still counts everything.

tools.name: FindCrossBlueprintCalls
tools.description: Finds indexed Blueprint function call nodes that target other Blueprint assets, with compact or full output modes.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

graphName.description: Optional Blueprint graph name filter, such as EventGraph or a function graph name.

outputMode.description: Optional response mode: summary, compact, or full. Defaults to summary.

includeSameBlueprintCalls.description: Optional. When true, include same-Blueprint function calls as well. Defaults to false.

tools.name: FindDataTableReferences
tools.description: Finds Blueprint nodes with a direct DataTable pin default, scanning registry referencers or one specified Blueprint.

tools.name: FindFeatureEntryPoints
tools.description: Finds likely starting assets for a feature by ranking indexed assets that match a query, optionally boosted by a related context asset.

query.description: Feature name, asset name, or path fragment to search for, for example inventory or Door.

blueprintsOnly.description: Whether to only return Blueprint assets. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Optional max result count from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

packagePath.description: Optional package path prefix such as /Game/UI to narrow the search.

contextObjectPath.description: Optional related asset object path to boost directly connected candidates.

contextPackageName.description: Optional related asset package name when object path is not available.

tools.name: FindUnusedBlueprintAssets
tools.description: Finds conservative project Blueprint candidates with no indexed incoming package dependencies. Results are leads for review, never proof that an asset is unused.

rootPath.description: Optional /Game package-path prefix. Alias of packagePath.

packagePath.description: Optional /Game package-path prefix. Alias of rootPath.

includePossibleRoots.description: Include low-confidence assets with indexed root-like or indirect-entry-point signals.

tools.name: GetActorInfo
tools.description: Returns detailed information about one actor from the active editor world, including transform, components, and attached actors.

actorObjectPath.description: Optional exact actor object path from the current editor world.

actorName.description: Optional actor name to resolve when actorObjectPath is not provided.

actorLabel.description: Optional actor label to resolve when actorObjectPath is not provided.

tools.name: GetAssetInfo
tools.description: Returns detailed Asset Registry information for one asset without loading it.

tools.name: GetAssetReferencers
tools.description: Returns indexed package referencers for one asset or package.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path to resolve into a package, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.MyAsset.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: GetAssetReferences
tools.description: Returns indexed package references for one asset or package.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path to resolve into a package, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.MyAsset.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: GetBlueprintClassDefaults
tools.description: Reads paged Blueprint class default values and parent overrides without modifying the asset.

onlyOverridden.description: Return values different from the parent CDO.

tools.name: GetBlueprintComponentDefaults
tools.description: Reads safely editable defaults from one existing Blueprint component template without mutating or compiling the asset.

componentName.description: Exact existing SCS component variable name.

tools.name: GetBlueprintComponentHierarchy
tools.description: Returns an indexed component hierarchy summary for one Blueprint asset.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: GetBlueprintDependencies
tools.description: Returns an indexed dependency summary for one Blueprint asset.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: GetBlueprintInfo
tools.description: Returns summary information about a Blueprint asset.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: GetBlueprintOverview
tools.description: Inspect a Blueprint asset in one bounded live read: parent, compile/dirty state, graph, variable, component and interface inventory. Filter and page members before requesting detailed pins. No compile, save, index refresh or level editing.

objectPath.description: Exact Blueprint asset object path. Required; no current-level fallback.

kind.description: all (default), graph, variable, component, or interface.

query.description: Case-insensitive member-name substring, at most 256 characters.

allowLoad.description: Load the exact asset if needed; default true. False restricts inspection to resident objects.

tools.name: GetDependencies
tools.description: Returns Asset Registry package dependencies for one asset or package.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path to resolve into a package, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.MyAsset.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: GetImplementedInterfaces
tools.description: Lists interfaces implemented by a Blueprint, with optional inherited interfaces.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

includeInherited.description: Whether to include inherited interfaces. Defaults to false.

tools.name: GetIndexStatus
tools.description: Returns status information for the local UnrealMCP project index.

tools.name: GetInputMappingContextMappings
tools.description: Reads back every key-mapping row (action, key, triggers, modifiers) in an InputMappingContext without loading it for editing.

tools.name: GetLevelActorDependencies
tools.description: Returns actor-to-asset relationships for one placed actor, including class source, attached actors, and referenced component assets.

actorObjectPath.description: Optional exact actor object path from the current editor world.

actorName.description: Optional actor name to resolve when actorObjectPath is not provided.

actorLabel.description: Optional actor label to resolve when actorObjectPath is not provided.

tools.name: GetMutationRequestStatus
tools.description: Returns the durable in-editor state and terminal response for one mutation operation ID.

operationId.description: Exact operation ID returned by a mutation request or adapter timeout.

tools.name: GetParentBlueprint
tools.description: Returns parent class information and resolves the parent Blueprint asset when applicable.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: GetReferencers
tools.description: Returns Asset Registry package referencers for one asset or package.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path to resolve into a package, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.MyAsset.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided, for example /Game/MyFolder/MyAsset.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: GetServerInfo
tools.description: Returns plugin, protocol, and engine version information.

tools.name: HealthCheck
tools.description: Returns plugin health and readiness information.

tools.name: InspectBlueprintNode
tools.description: Explains one or more indexed Blueprint nodes, including immediate previous and next connected nodes plus trace hints.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

query.description: Node search query matched against node title, member name, node name, graph name, or node type.

nodeGuid.description: Optional exact Blueprint node GUID. Use this when you already know the node identity.

graphName.description: Optional Blueprint graph name filter, such as EventGraph or a function graph name.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of matching nodes to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: InspectDataTableRows
tools.description: Reads paged DataTable rows as export text and reports soft references that cannot resolve, without changing the table.

tools.name: InspectEnhancedInputActionWiring
tools.description: Finds Enhanced Input Action event nodes and reports exact Started/Triggered/Ongoing/Canceled/Completed execution routes.

inputActionPath.description: Optional exact InputAction object path filter.

nodeGuid.description: Optional exact Enhanced Input node GUID filter.

tools.name: InspectLiveBlueprint
tools.description: Read-only live graph/node/pin inspection, including a map's embedded Level Blueprint. Defaults to the current editor level. No index, loading, PIE, compilation or saving.

objectPath.description: Exact resident Blueprint or graph object path, including embedded LevelScriptBlueprint objects. Never loads assets.

mapPath.description: Loaded map package, world object path, or exact level path in the editor world. Exclusive with objectPath/level.

level.description: current (default) or persistent in the open editor world. Exclusive with objectPath/mapPath.

graphPath.description: Optional exact graph object path within the resolved Blueprint.

mode.description: graphs (default) or nodes. Node results include exact pins and links.

outputMode.description: full (default) or compact. Compact nodes include title, member, and visible links as title.pin endpoints.

nodeGuid.description: Optional exact node GUID; implies nodes mode.

query.description: Optional member/title/name substring; implies nodes mode.

tools.name: LayoutBlueprintNodes
tools.description: Deterministically lays out an explicit Blueprint node set by execution-flow depth with configurable spacing, collision avoidance, dry-run, and optional save.

nodeGuids.description: Explicit stable node GUIDs to arrange.

dryRun.description: Return proposed positions without moving nodes.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: ListActors
tools.description: Lists actors from the active editor world so agents can inspect current level composition without modifying it.

limit.description: Optional max number of actors to return. Defaults to 250.

selectedOnly.description: Whether to only list selected actors. Defaults to false.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive actor name or label filter.

className.description: Optional actor class name or class path filter.

tools.name: ListAssets
tools.description: Lists assets under a package path without loading them.

packagePath.description: Package path to list, for example /Game or /Game/MyFolder. Defaults to /Game.

recursive.description: Whether to recurse into subfolders. Defaults to false.

classPath.description: Optional class path filter, for example /Script/Engine.Blueprint.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 200.

tools.name: ListBlueprintGraphs
tools.description: Lists indexed graphs for one Blueprint with stable graph identity, GUID, type, entry node, and node count.

tools.name: ListBlueprintLocalVariables
tools.description: Lists the local variables (name, GUID, type, default) of one Blueprint function graph.

graphName.description: Function graph name (or name::guid) from ListBlueprintGraphs.

graphGuid.description: Function graph GUID; alternative to graphName.

tools.name: ListBlueprintNodePins
tools.description: Lists live pins for one Blueprint node by stable graph and node GUID, including IDs, directions, types, defaults, and exact linked endpoints.

tools.name: ListChildBlueprints
tools.description: Lists child Blueprints whose parent class is this Blueprint's generated class.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

recursive.description: Whether to include descendants beyond direct children. Defaults to false.

tools.name: ListComponents
tools.description: Lists Blueprint simple-construction-script components and hierarchy data.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: ListFolders
tools.description: Lists known Asset Registry package folders under a base path.

path.description: Base package path, for example /Game or /Game/MyFolder. Defaults to /Game.

recursive.description: Whether to recurse into nested subpaths. Defaults to false.

tools.name: ListFunctions
tools.description: Lists Blueprint-declared function graphs and interface graphs.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: ListSelectedActors
tools.description: Lists the currently selected actors from the active editor world.

tools.name: ListTools
tools.description: Lists all registered Unreal MCP tools and schemas.

tools.name: ListUnrealMCPAutomationTests
tools.description: Lists registered UnrealMCP editor automation tests available to the bounded static regression runner.

nameContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring applied only within registered UnrealMCP.* tests.

tools.name: ListVariables
tools.description: Lists Blueprint-defined variables and their pin types.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor

tools.name: MoveBlueprintNode
tools.description: Moves a Blueprint node using explicit or relative collision-aware placement. Supports dry-run and optional save.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh.

tools.name: PlanProjectRefactor
tools.description: Builds a deterministic, evidence-backed, non-mutating Blueprint refactor plan from indexed architecture analyses. It never changes assets and never treats unused candidates as deletion instructions.

rootPath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

packagePath.description: Optional /Game package-path scope. rootPath and packagePath are aliases.

featureBoundaries.description: Optional /Game feature boundaries to analyze independently, up to 20.

includeEvidence.description: Include detailed source analysis objects in addition to compact evidence references.

tools.name: RefreshBlueprintCallSites
tools.description: Finds every same-Blueprint and cross-Blueprint call site of a Blueprint function via the project index and reconstructs each call node to match the function's current signature, compiling callers without saving.

ownerBlueprint.description: Object path of the Blueprint that owns the function whose signature changed.

functionName.description: Name of the function whose call sites should be refreshed.

compileCallers.description: Compile each affected caller Blueprint after reconstruction. Defaults to true.

refreshIndex.description: Reserved: only takes effect once an affected asset is saved and reindexed. Defaults to false.

dryRun.description: Report which indexed call sites would be reconstructed without mutating any asset.

operationId.description: Optional client-assigned ID for mutation-request tracking via GetMutationRequestStatus.

tools.name: RefreshProjectIndex
tools.description: Refreshes only changed, added, deleted, or explicitly requested project assets in the existing UnrealMCP index. This is cheaper than BuildProjectIndex.

objectPaths.description: Optional Blueprint asset object paths to refresh. Omit to auto-detect changed, added, and deleted project assets.

tools.name: RemoveBlueprintLocalVariable
tools.description: Removes one local variable from a Blueprint function graph. Requires confirm=true unless dryRun=true; reports how many Get/Set nodes still reference the name.

graphName.description: Function graph name (or name::guid) from ListBlueprintGraphs.

graphGuid.description: Function graph GUID; alternative to graphName.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after the edit (default false).

tools.name: RemoveDataTableRow
tools.description: Transactionally edits one DataTable row in memory; leaves the asset dirty for an explicit save.

tools.name: RemoveInputMappingContextMapping
tools.description: Removes one exact existing Action+Key mapping row from an InputMappingContext. Fails clearly rather than guessing when zero or more than one row matches.

inputActionPath.description: Exact UInputAction asset object path currently mapped.

key.description: FKey name of the exact row to remove, for example LeftMouseButton.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the row that would be removed without removing it.

confirm.description: Required true for a real removal after inspecting the dry-run row.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index.

tools.name: ResetBlueprintClassDefaults
tools.description: Resets inherited Blueprint class defaults to their parent CDO values.

onlyOverridden.description: Return values different from the parent CDO.

save.description: Save this Blueprint package; default false.

tools.name: RetargetBlueprintNode
tools.description: Retargets a cast node (including a 'Bad cast node' whose class was deleted) to newClassPath without needing the old class. Output links whose pins still exist survive; the old class-named result pin's links move to the new result pin. Requires confirm=true unless dryRun=true.

nodeGuid.description: GUID of the cast node to retarget.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after the edit (default false).

tools.name: RunUnrealMCPAutomationTest
tools.description: Runs one exact synchronous UnrealMCP.* editor automation test and returns structured execution evidence.

testName.description: Exact registered synchronous UnrealMCP.* automation test name.

confirm.description: Required acknowledgement that the test may create temporary editor assets.

tools.name: RunUnrealMCPAutomationTests
tools.description: Runs a bounded explicit list of synchronous UnrealMCP editor automation tests and returns one suite result.

testNames.description: Explicit registered UnrealMCP.* tests in preferred order; isolation-sensitive negative tests run last.

confirm.description: Required acknowledgement that tests may create temporary editor assets.

continueOnFailure.description: Run the remaining requested tests after a failure. Defaults true.

tools.name: SaveAllDirtyPackages
tools.description: Saves every dirty package without prompting, so a subsequent editor shutdown does not block on a save-confirmation dialog. Supports dry-run to report dirty packages without saving.

tools.name: SaveBlueprint
tools.description: Explicitly saves one Blueprint asset, refusing by default to write a Blueprint whose compile is not up to date, and reports its measured package dirty state.

requireUpToDateCompile.description: Refuse to save a Blueprint whose compile status is not up to date. Defaults to true.

tools.name: SaveDataTable
tools.description: Saves exactly one DataTable package after explicit row edits and reports the resulting dirty state.

tools.name: SaveValidatedBlueprints
tools.description: Saves an ordered list of already-compiled, dirty Blueprint assets one at a time, stopping at the first asset that is not saveable and reporting which assets are saved versus still dirty and unsaved.

objectPaths.description: Ordered Blueprint object paths to save, typically the owner plus every reconstructed caller from RefreshBlueprintCallSites.

dryRun.description: Report which assets would be saved without saving any of them.

continueOnFailure.description: Continue attempting later assets after one fails, instead of stopping immediately. Defaults to false.

requireUpToDateCompile.description: Refuse to save a dirty asset whose Blueprint status is not up to date. Defaults to true.

refreshIndex.description: Partially refresh the project index for each asset saved. Defaults to true.

operationId.description: Optional client-assigned ID for mutation-request tracking via GetMutationRequestStatus.

tools.name: SearchAssets
tools.description: Searches the Asset Registry without loading matching assets.

query.description: Case-insensitive asset name or path fragment.

tools.name: SetBlueprintClassDefaults
tools.description: Preflights and transactionally sets Blueprint class defaults, including inherited properties.

values.description: Property name to Unreal export-text value.

save.description: Save this Blueprint package; default false.

allowDirty.description: Allow a pre-existing dirty Blueprint; default false.

tools.name: SetBlueprintComponentDefaults
tools.description: Transactionally validates and updates safely editable defaults on one existing Blueprint component template.

componentName.description: Exact existing SCS component variable name.

propertyDefaults.description: Properties expressed as JSON primitives or Unreal export-text strings.

dryRun.description: Validate and return normalized values without mutation.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile after a real change; defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh the index after a real change; defaults true.

tools.name: SetBlueprintFunctionMetadata
tools.description: Idempotently sets category, description, pure, and const metadata on a Blueprint function graph.

graphGuid.description: Stable GUID of the target function graph.

category.description: Optional function category; an empty string clears it.

description.description: Optional function description/tooltip; an empty string clears it.

dryRun.description: Report the effective metadata without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after mutation.

tools.name: SetBlueprintLocalVariableDefault
tools.description: Sets the export-text default of an existing Blueprint function local variable.

graphName.description: Function graph name (or name::guid) from ListBlueprintGraphs.

graphGuid.description: Function graph GUID; alternative to graphName.

defaultValue.description: New default as Unreal export text; empty string clears it.

dryRun.description: Validate the target without changing it.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save after setting the default.

tools.name: SetBlueprintNodeComment
tools.description: Sets a Blueprint node comment and optional comment-bubble visibility state. Idempotent, transactional, and supports dry-run and optional save.

comment.description: Replacement node comment; use an empty string to clear it.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after mutation.

tools.name: SetBlueprintParameter
tools.description: Changes the type and/or name of one parameter on a custom event, function entry or function result node, updating call sites in one undoable transaction. Rolls back when links would break (unless confirm=true) or compilation fails.

nodeGuid.description: Custom event, function entry or function result node GUID (any graph, including collapsed).

newName.description: Optional new parameter name; call sites are renamed too.

type.description: Optional new type (same vocabulary as AddBlueprintFunctionParameter), e.g. object.

typeObjectPath.description: Class/struct/enum path for object, class, struct or enum types, e.g. /Game/BP_Weapon.BP_Weapon_C.

containerType.description: none, array, set, or map. Default none.

valueTypeObjectPath.description: Class path for object/class Map values.

dryRun.description: Apply, measure broken links, then roll back.

confirm.description: Required when the change breaks existing links.

compile.description: Compile after the edit and roll back on new errors. Default true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after a successful edit.

tools.name: SetBlueprintPinDefaultObject
tools.description: Sets an exact UObject or UClass default on an unconnected Blueprint input pin using stable graph, node, and pin identity. Supports dry-run and optional save.

graphName.description: Graph name; graphGuid is preferred when available.

pinId.description: Stable input pin GUID; preferred over pinName.

pinName.description: Input pin name when pinId is unavailable.

defaultObjectPath.description: Exact UObject path, /Script/... UClass path, or generated Blueprint class path ending in _C.

dryRun.description: Validate resolution and compatibility without mutating the Blueprint.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save the Blueprint and partially refresh its project-index entry after mutation.

tools.name: SetBlueprintPinDefaultValue
tools.description: Sets a validated literal default on an unconnected Blueprint input pin using stable node/pin identity. Supports dry-run and optional save.

objectPath.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

graphName.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

nodeGuid.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

pinId.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

pinName.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

defaultValue.description: Blueprint graph/node/pin selector or literal value.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh after mutation.

tools.name: SetBlueprintPinSplit
tools.description: Splits a Blueprint struct pin into member sub-pins, or explicitly recombines it, using stable graph/node/pin identifiers.

pinId.description: Exact parent or member pin GUID.

split.description: True to split; false to recombine. Defaults to true.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the current pin model without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after mutation.

tools.name: SetBlueprintSequenceOutputs
tools.description: Sets a Sequence node to 2-32 execution outputs. Removing outputs requires explicit confirmation, with separate confirmation for linked pins.

desiredOutputCount.description: Desired output count, clamped to the supported range 2-32.

confirmRemove.description: Required to remove any Sequence output pins.

confirmRemoveLinkedPins.description: Additionally required when removed outputs have links.

dryRun.description: Preview count and affected trailing pins without mutation.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index after mutation.

tools.name: SetDataTableRowFields
tools.description: Transactionally edits one DataTable row in memory; leaves the asset dirty for an explicit save.

tools.name: SetInputMappingContextMappingKey
tools.description: Replaces the key of one exact Action+Key row, preserving its position, action, inline objects and metadata. Static asset editing only; no runtime mapping rebuild.

key.description: Expected current key; ambiguity or a stale key is rejected.

dryRun.description: Validate on a detached preview and report before/proposed row without editing.

confirm.description: Required true for a real replacement.

saveAfterEdit.description: Optional save and partial index refresh; default false. A no-op does not save.

tools.name: SpliceBlueprintExecFlow
tools.description: Atomically inserts an ordered chain of existing nodes into one exact Blueprint execution link, with revision checks, idempotent retry, rollback, and compile-before-save.

objectPath.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

graphName.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

graphGuid.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

spliceId.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

expectedGraphRevision.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

sourceNodeGuid.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

sourcePinName.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

targetNodeGuid.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

targetPinName.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

operationId.description: Blueprint, graph, splice, revision, node, or exact execution-pin selector.

insertedNodes.description: Ordered existing nodes to insert. Each node must have currently unwired exact execution input/output pins.

nodeGuid.description: Exact inserted node and execution-pin selector.

inputPinName.description: Exact inserted node and execution-pin selector.

outputPinName.description: Exact inserted node and execution-pin selector.

confirm.description: Required true for a real splice, because the existing execution link is broken and rewired.

dryRun.description: Validate the exact route and ordered chain without mutation.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile before any save. Defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh after successful compilation. Defaults false.

tools.name: SummarizeBlueprintCluster
tools.description: Summarizes the nearby indexed asset cluster around a starting Blueprint or asset.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided.

limit.description: Optional max number of neighbor assets. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: TraceBlueprintFlow
tools.description: Traces Blueprint graph flow from the project index; refreshes the selected Blueprint once if start nodes are missing.

objectPath.description: Blueprint asset object path, for example /Game/MyFolder/BP_Door.BP_Door.

graphName.description: Optional Blueprint graph name filter, such as EventGraph or a function graph name.

startNodeQuery.description: Optional node, event, function, variable, graph, or pin text to choose start nodes. When omitted, graph entry nodes are used.

outputMode.description: Optional response mode: summary, compact, or full. Defaults to summary.

resolveExternalMembers.description: Optional. When true, node member owners are resolved back to indexed assets so cross-Blueprint references are visible in the trace output. Defaults to true.

expandCalls.description: Optional. When true, the trace may enter called functions or custom events using a bounded call-expansion budget. Defaults to true.

followCrossBlueprintCalls.description: Optional. When true, bounded call expansion may continue into target Blueprints as well. Defaults to true.

direction.description: Traversal direction: forward, backward, or both. Defaults to forward.

maxDepth.description: Optional max traversal depth across graph edges. Defaults to 4, clamped to 0-12.

maxNodes.description: Optional max traced node count. Defaults to 40, clamped to 1-200.

maxStartNodes.description: Optional max number of matched start nodes to seed the trace. Defaults to 8, clamped to 1-32.

maxCallDepth.description: Optional max number of function or custom-event call expansions. Defaults to 1, clamped to 0-6.

tools.name: TraceFeatureFlow
tools.description: Traces a small indexed feature flow around a starting Blueprint or asset using dependencies and referencers.

objectPath.description: Optional asset object path, for example /Game/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor.

packageName.description: Optional package name when objectPath is not provided.

maxDepth.description: Optional max traversal depth from 1 to 3. Defaults to 2.

maxNodes.description: Optional max nodes to emit. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: TraceLiveBlueprintFlow
tools.description: Trace live Blueprint execution and data links from an event or node, including embedded Level Blueprints, delays, and resident function/macro bodies. Read-only; no asset index or runtime evaluation.

objectPath.description: Exact resident Blueprint or graph object path, including embedded LevelScriptBlueprint objects. Never loads assets.

mapPath.description: Loaded map package, world object path, or exact level path in the editor world. Exclusive with objectPath/level.

level.description: current (default) or persistent in the open editor world. Exclusive with objectPath/mapPath.

graphPath.description: Optional exact graph object path within the resolved Blueprint.

startNodeGuid.description: Exact start node GUID. Exclusive with startEvent; use graphPath if ambiguous.

startEvent.description: Exact event member name. Defaults to BeginPlay (ReceiveBeginPlay).

includePins.description: Include complete authored pin defaults and links for each node; default true.

maxNodes.description: Traversal bound: maxNodes default 100/max 1000; maxDepth default 128/max 512; maxCallDepth default 4/max 16. Limits return explicit frontier evidence.

maxDepth.description: Traversal bound: maxNodes default 100/max 1000; maxDepth default 128/max 512; maxCallDepth default 4/max 16. Limits return explicit frontier evidence.

maxCallDepth.description: Traversal bound: maxNodes default 100/max 1000; maxDepth default 128/max 512; maxCallDepth default 4/max 16. Limits return explicit frontier evidence.

tools.name: ValidateBlueprint
tools.description: Runs a no-save compile validation for one Blueprint and returns structured diagnostics and dirty state.

tools.name: WireBlueprintEventToFunction
tools.description: Idempotently ensures a custom event calls one exact Blueprint-callable function, optionally through a Blueprint component/member target. Refuses to replace existing event flow.

graphName.description: Exact graph name; use graphGuid when ambiguous.

eventName.description: Custom event to create or reuse.

ownerClassPath.description: Exact class that owns the BlueprintCallable function.

targetVariableName.description: Optional Blueprint component/member variable used as the call target.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile the touched Blueprint once. Defaults to true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the touched asset once. Defaults to true.

tools.name: WireEnhancedInputActionToComponent
tools.description: Idempotently inserts one component function call into an exact Enhanced Input action phase while preserving its existing execution continuation.

inputActionPath.description: Exact InputAction object path; nodeGuid is preferred when duplicate action nodes exist.

nodeGuid.description: Exact Enhanced Input Action node GUID.

phase.description: Started, Triggered, Ongoing, Canceled, or Completed.

ownerClassPath.description: Exact class owning the impure BlueprintCallable function.

targetVariableName.description: Existing Blueprint component/member variable used as call target.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile once after mutation; defaults true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and refresh once after mutation; defaults true.

tools.name: WireSelectionWorkflow
tools.description: Idempotently scaffolds four collection-backed helper functions (SelectOne, ToggleSelection, ClearSelection, ContainsSelection) over a named array/set-of-object selection variable, composed from existing Blueprint authoring primitives.

elementTypeObjectPath.description: Class path of the object type the selection collection holds, e.g. an Actor subclass.

selectionVariableName.description: Collection variable name to create or reuse. Defaults to SelectedActors.

collectionType.description: array or set. Defaults to array.

dryRun.description: Report a structural plan without mutating anything.

compileAfterEdit.description: Compile once after scaffolding. Defaults to true.

saveAfterEdit.description: Save and partially refresh the index once after scaffolding. Defaults to true.
